name: Variables and assignment
description: A variable names a value, and assignment copies the current value of the right-hand side into it.

name: Data types
description: Values have types such as int, float, str and bool, and the type decides what an operator does.

name: Arithmetic operators
description: Python calculates with + - * / as well as // for floor division, % for the remainder and ** for powers.

name: Comparison and logic
description: Comparisons such as == and < give True or False, and and, or and not combine them.

name: if and else
description: An if statement runs one block when its condition is True, and else runs another when it is False.

name: for loops with range
description: range(start, stop) counts from start up to, but not including, stop, so the loop runs stop minus start times.

name: while loops
description: A while loop checks its condition before each pass, and always finishes the body it has started.

name: Running totals
description: A loop builds a total by starting from zero and adding to the same variable on every pass.

name: Nested loops
description: An inner loop runs completely on every pass of the outer loop, so the passes multiply.

name: Lists and indexing
description: A list holds items in order, and its first item is at index 0.

name: Traversing a list
description: A for loop can visit every item of a list in order, for example to add them up.

name: Functions
description: A function is a named block of code that takes parameters and can return a value.

name: What a network is
description: A network links computers so they can share data and resources.

name: LAN, MAN and WAN
description: Networks are grouped by the area they cover, from a single building to the whole world.

name: Network topologies
description: Bus, star, ring and tree topologies describe how the devices in a network are connected.

name: Transmission media
description: Data travels over wired media such as twisted pair and optical fibre, or wirelessly by radio waves.

name: Network protocols
description: Protocols such as HTTP, FTP and TCP/IP are the rules devices follow to exchange data.

name: Internet services
description: The internet carries services such as the web, email, e-commerce and video conferencing.

name: HTML page structure
description: An HTML page uses tags, with a head for information about the page and a body for its content.

name: Formatting text
description: Headings, paragraphs and formatting tags control how text appears on a page.

name: Ordered and unordered lists
description: The ol and ul tags make numbered and bulleted lists, with an li tag for each item.

name: Images and links
description: The img tag places a picture on a page, and the a tag links to another page.

name: Tables
description: The table, tr, th and td tags arrange content in rows and columns.

name: Forms
description: The form and input tags collect information from the person using a page.

name: Netiquette
description: Netiquette is the set of rules for behaving politely and responsibly online.

name: Digital footprint
description: Most of what a person does online leaves a lasting record that others may be able to see.

name: Copyright and plagiarism
description: Creative work belongs to its creator, so it should be credited and used only as its licence allows.

name: Staying safe online
description: Strong passwords and care with personal details protect people from many online risks.

name: Cyber crime
description: Phishing, hacking and cyberbullying are harmful online acts that should be recognised and reported.
